settings.desc: At Ledsone, we are committed to getting your order to you as quickly and efficiently as possible. Please review our shipping policy below for details on processing times, costs, and delivery estimates.

We currently ship to addresses within the United States.

  • Standard Shipping: A flat rate of $3.00 applies to all orders under $34.99
  • Free Shipping: Automatically applied to orders of $34.99 or more (after discounts).

Handling Time: 0-1 Business Day.

  • Orders placed before 2:00 PM (PST) are typically processed the same day.
  • We process and ship orders Monday through Friday. We do not ship on weekends or U.S. federal holidays.

settings.title: How long will it take for my order to be processed?
settings.content: We process all orders within 1 business day. Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed the following business day.

settings.title: When will I receive my order?
settings.content: Once your order has been processed, you can expect to receive it within 3-7 business days. We ship using reliable carriers like USPS and UPS to get your package to you safely and efficiently.

settings.title: How much does shipping cost?
settings.content: We charge a flat-rate shipping fee of $3 per order. This cost will be displayed at checkout.

settings.title: How do I use a discount code?
settings.content: You can enter your discount code in the designated field at checkout. Once you apply the code, you will see your order total update to reflect the discount.

settings.title: Are there any limitations on discount codes?
settings.content: Yes. Discount codes may be limited to one use per customer, may have a minimum purchase amount, or may not be valid on certain items. Please refer to the specific terms and conditions of the promotion for more details

settings.title: Will I receive a tracking number?
settings.content: Yes! As soon as your order ships, we'll send you a shipment confirmation email with your tracking number. You can use this to follow your package's journey right to your doorstep. Please note that it may take up to 24 hours for the tracking information to become active.

settings.title: My order is shipping in multiple boxes. Why?
settings.content: For larger orders, we may ship items in multiple boxes to ensure they arrive safely. This helps prevent damage and ensures everything fits within the carrier's size limitations.

settings.title: My order arrived damaged. What's the process?
settings.content: We take great care in packaging your order. However, if your items arrive damaged, please contact our Customer Service team immediately at [Your Customer Service Email] or by [mention your contact method, e.g., using our contact page].
